steps.purpose: Confirm the required operational fields are available.
Measure the affected European teams before and after the change.
Measure other European teams over the same periods.
Validate whether the observed differences are statistically distinguishable.
Rank team-level contributions to the Europe-wide conversion movement.
Check post-change response-time behavior against the robust pre-change baseline.
Check nearby business events for a plausible operational explanation.
Separate supported findings from causal overclaims.
